# mmx-ran-1.2 — a Hobbit Ranger, half a life

**115 asks (150 to 265), depth 1, character level 2, 366 gold, wealth 910,
13/17 hit points, alive.** The game was killed by a server restart at ask 265,
not by anything in the dungeon.

| | |
|---|---|
| seed | 137 (the same seed and the same character as mmx-ran-1, continued) |
| character | Hobbit Ranger "Runner", STR 15, INT 12, WIS 16, DEX 18/20, CON 14 |
| stats | Cur AC 10 (naked was 2), HP 12/12 at the start of this half, 17/17 at the end |
| depth | 1 throughout — **no down staircase was ever seen** |
| turns | 11044 game turns |
| experience | 10 (character level 2): 3 grey mould + 1 grey mould + 2 wild dog, and the floating eye |
| gold | 366 (126 inherited, 180 found on the floor, 60 spent) |
| wealth | 910 |
| what it bought | the Soft Leather Armour [8,+0] for 84 gold, and the Scroll of Word of Recall |

## What happened, in order

1. **The town (asks 150-180, thirty asks).** I came in with 150 gold and a
   naked Ranger. I walked to the Armoury, bought the **Soft Leather Armour
   (+8 armour class, 84 gold)** and wore it: Cur AC 2 became 10. Then I read
   the **Scroll of Word of Recall** and rested: the Recall fired and pulled me
   down to a fresh depth 1 in **two asks** instead of the nineteen it would
   have cost to walk to the town's staircase.
2. **The fresh depth 1 (asks 181-265).** I swept the level: the corridors
   along rows 9 and 19, the big lit rooms, the vertical corridor at x=29. I
   found **60 gold**, then **120 gold**, killed a floating eye, a grey mould
   and two wild dogs, and **reached character level 2**. A **teleport trap**
   fired me from the western middle of the level to its far north-east
   corner.
3. **The crash (ask 265).** The server restarted and the game's process died.
   `borg_runner carry-on --run runs/mmx-ran-1.2` replayed this run's own keys
   into a fresh run and reported `identical: true`, so the character came back
   exactly: level 2, 366 gold, AC 10, depth 1, 13/17 hit points, waiting at
   ask 265.

## What I would tell the next Ranger

- **The town costs one tile per ask.** Every object on the square you step on
  makes the game disturb you, and a disturbance drops the rest of your key
  string. The town's floor is full of goods the map does not draw, so a
  twenty-key chain moves one tile and a path-walk one or two. This is the
  single most expensive thing in the game and it is not in any manual: plan
  the town trip as **two or three asks**, not fifteen.
- **The Word of Recall is the way out of the town, not the way home.** Read in
  the town it takes you **down** to the deepest level you have reached, after
  15 to 34 player actions, and a rest of 60 covers the wait. It costs the
  scroll, so spend it on a trip you are sure of, not on a panic.
- **The Soft Leather Armour is the best 84 gold in the game.** Armour class
  buys misses, not padding: at AC 10 a depth-2 crow's hit chance is about 44
  per cent against 86 per cent at AC 2, and at 12 hit points that is the
  difference between a fight and a corpse.
- **Do not fight an armoured monster.** A giant black ant (11 hp, AC 24) and a
  small kobold (8 hp, AC 24) are outside what a Ranger with a bow and a
  flask of oil can win on depth 1: the bow's to-hit of 32 against AC 24 is 53
  per cent and the oil's to-hit of 11 is on the flat 12 per cent floor.
  The grey mould (2 hp, AC 1, 3 experience, never moves) and the wild dog
  (3 hp, AC 3) are the right targets.

The rest of this life — the second sweep, the last of the level, the
measurements of the whole-level map and the final numbers — is in
[mmx-ran-1.3's report](mmx-ran-1.3/REPORT.md), and the measurements
themselves are in `knowledge/mmx-ran-1.2.md` and `knowledge/mmx-ran-1.3.md`.
